result.summary: Updates the Guix time-machine commit to pick up upstream Guix package updates and bumps python-lief to 0.17.6 in CI lint requirements. In manifest_gui.scm, it also wraps python-lief and nsis-x86_64 to disable test execution on transitive dependencies (python-psutil, python-pytest-xprocess, python-sh) that fail when compiled natively on RISC-V architectures.
result.problem: Running Guix builds on native riscv64-linux hosts fails because python-lief 0.17.5 transitively depends on python-msgspec, which lacked riscv64 support in the older Guix pin. In addition, several transitive dependencies fail their test suites when built natively on riscv64.
evidence: PR description quotes the error on RISC-V systems: 'guix shell: error: package python-lief@0.17.5 does not support riscv64-linux', tracked in issue #36232.
Upstream Guix issue 10128 documents native riscv64 test failures in packages like python-psutil.
result.changed_since_previous: Now disables tests for python-psutil under nsis-x86_64 in addition to python-lief's transitive dependencies.
result.card: Updates the Guix time-machine pin and bumps python-lief to 0.17.6 to unblock running Guix builds natively on RISC-V systems. In manifest_gui.scm, it skips tests on failing transitive dependencies (python-psutil, python-pytest-xprocess, and python-sh) for python-lief and nsis-x86_64. This resolves issue #36232 where guix shell failed due to python-msgspec omitting riscv64 from its supported systems.

risk.why: Altering the Guix time-machine pin and manifest package derivations could affect reproducible build environments or break binary generation for release targets.
